text:
natalie: AegisSensors flagged invoice spikes for a handful of customers after their firmware v2.1 rollout. Looks like sequence_id resets + local TZ minute buckets. Need quick mitigation and a recon plan.

pete: Short summary: some devices reset seq_id on reboot, aggregator dedup relies only on seq_id so reboots cause duplicates in minute buckets -> overcount. Also Aegis sends minute_start in local tz (America/Sao_Paulo) and DST rules differ, causing hour-boundary misassignments.

ari: Can you paste a sample of the partner payload and an example of the duplicate pattern?

aegis-bot: sample payload (anonymized):
```json
{"device_id":"ae-9001","minute_start":"2026-06-10T23:59:00-03:00","seq_id":"00000012","count":60}
```
Duplicate scenario: device reboots at 23:59:30 and sends another minute bucket with seq_id reset to 00000001 for same minute window.

natalie: Immediate controls I propose:
- require either seq_id OR content_hash for dedupe; if seq_id present but decreased vs last seen, treat as reset and require seq_nonce or content_hash
- ingest should canonicalize minute_start -> UTC using tz info in payload (client-provided offset or named tz)
- ingest returns PT-400-AMBSEQ when seq decreases without nonce

pete: For a short mitigation we can accept a soft-dedup window: if (device, minute_start) already exists within last 48h, mark incoming as potential duplicate and route to manual review queue instead of applying to invoice. This buys time.

ari: Backfill path: Aegis uploaded 21 days of minute archives to s3://aegis-prod/archives/2026-06-*.ndjson. Plan: dry-run transform -> compute corrected hour buckets -> produce adjustments. We'll pilot on 5 affected accounts.

finance-bot: Proposed thresholds: auto-adjust if delta <= 0.5% OR delta_hours <= 2h; billing-review if 0.5%<delta<=3% OR 2h<delta<=20h; escalate if delta>3% OR delta_hours>20h. Legal to review for regulated accounts.

natalie: Adapter schema change (minimal) draft:
```json
{"usage_batch":[{"usage_key":"sha256(partner+device+minute_epoch+nonce)","sku":"aegis-core-hour","qty":"0.01666667","window_start":"2026-06-10T23:59:00Z","seq_id":"00000001","nonce":"<optional>","content_hash":"<opt>"}],"signature":"base64sig"}
```
Notes: accept nonce OR content_hash to prove uniqueness across resets. qty string = minutes as hours.

pete: Action items:
- natalie: schedule partner call + draft customer note (ETA 24h)
- ari: dry-run backfill on 5 pilots + produce diff CSV (ETA 72h)
- pete: implement soft-dedup + API error PT-400-AMBSEQ (ETA 48h)
- finance-bot: loop legal/accounting on thresholds & credit policy (ETA 48h)

ari: Tests: seq reset replay, tz offsets (UTC vs -03:00 vs named tz), DST transitions, manual nonce path, S3 dry-run parity. Also add property test: sum(minute-fragments)->hour equals ledger sum within 1e-8.

natalie: Customer note draft for review: "We detected a metering alignment issue affecting some AegisSensors integrations due to device firmware resets and timezone misalignments. Verified discrepancies will be corrected on the next billing cycle or earlier if finance approves. Contact support@redwood.ai for concerns."

pete: I'll gate deploy of soft-dedup behind dark launch flag for 2h to monitor false positives. Will add metrics: duplicate_detected_count, ambseq_reject_rate, dedupe_manual_queue_len.

ari: I'll post S3 test paths and bootstrap the dry-run tomorrow morning. s3://aegis-prod/archives/2026-06-*.ndjson

finance-bot: Created ticket PART-AEGIS-1769 and scheduled daily reconcile job at 00:20 UTC to compare partner-minute-agg -> invoice-hours.

natalie: OK scheduling partner call 9am PT. Pete you'll walk API error codes; Ari bring dry-run plan; Finance will present thresholds. Thanks all.

pete: :thumbsup: will have API examples ready.

ari: :white_check_mark: will have pilot diffs.

natalie: I'll convert actions to Jira and post the runbook after call.
